trickyParts: The claim that was wrong was a negative one, and a variable the worker image's own ENV sets is in every process of the container whatever the pod spec's env carries: PATH is the only such name in the table (the image's ENV block at worker.Dockerfile:522-526 sets OMP_PROFILE, LEGION_OMP_PATH, HOME, DO_NOT_TRACK and PATH, and PATH is the only one of the five the table lists).

The agent's own PATH in a live role container is /opt/legion/bin:/opt/legion/pi-envoy/bin:/opt/omp/bin:… — the pi-envoy plugin prepends its own bin at session start, after the runtime has rendered the value. The table's row documents what podPath renders (/opt/legion/bin first, then the image's own), which is what PID 1 carries and what the first PATH field is in both processes; the plugin's extra second entry is not the runtime's and is out of this issue's scope. Worth knowing before someone reads the two PATHs side by side.
